conditions.action: Public interface_dispatch: focus exact fixture, SHIFT down, wait_update 30000ms, SHIFT up, release_all. Allow up to 12 seconds for native producer startup before declaring SHIFT-down unobserved; action lease is 45 seconds.
conditions.failure: Retain first failure/unknown and never replay this ID. On any post-dispatch gate failure, send exactly one standard interface_cancel for the exact call, drain/collect its response, poll exact-call interface_results to terminal or bounded UNKNOWN, record interface_close, and only then stop the relay. Emergency release only for owned fixture and record it.
conditions.gate: Before any stdout drain require actual pipe available bytes >= GetNamedPipeInfo outbound capacity; one underlying OS stdout write started and remains incomplete; server-side cancel returned; independent same-generation SHIFT-up observed.
conditions.pressure: After setup, stop parent stdout reads. Send sixteen ordinary interface_observe requests, one ordinary interface_clock request, then standard interface_cancel for the exact call.
conditions.setup: Open only the fresh fixture foreground through Computer Use before dispatch; exact fixture PID/HWND and target generation must match the independent Win32 preflight.
conditions.success: All blocked-pipe gate conditions precede drain, retained exact-call result says cancellation recovered and release_confirmed=true, final same-generation SHIFT-up; fixture and original foreground cleanup pass.
conditions.custody: The runner may not infer action start from a queued response or infer no effect from absent SHIFT-down. On gate failure, exact call result and close receipt must be captured before teardown; unresolved custody remains UNKNOWN and forbids replay.

operator_boundary: Do not launch, focus, or send input to existing GZDoom windows or any pre-existing application. Do not use WSLc or Docker.
preflight: Verify R43's exact FileExistsError path is removed by paired factory roots and R44's native producer receives a 12-second startup-observation window; run syntax-only compilation and freeze all source hashes before launching the fixture.
question: Can the public stdio relay route cancellation and supervised Win32 release while its actual child-process stdout OS pipe is full and a write is blocked?
scope: One newly owned synthetic Win32 fixture. Real child stdin/stdout OS pipes; the in-process MCP adapter calls a real supervised-Win32 MCP server with paired native owner/producer factories. No GZDoom/MAP01, WSLc, Docker, provider/model, task effect, efficiency or reliability claim.
R43_harness_fix: Build the owner and producer independently from the distinct root arguments supplied by create_server; never initialize the producer at the MCP request journal root.
R44_startup_adjustment: The R44 result showed the producer was authorized but SHIFT-down had not appeared within 3 seconds. R45 extends only the bounded observation window and lease, without assuming the input was dispatched.
